ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominance of low-intensity pixel values (black) across the macro-surface; high-intensity pixels (white) are highly localized at distal tips and along the proximal baseline due to water spray, resulting in a very low white-to-black pixel ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominantly uniform low-intensity field; a single high-contrast circular white ring is located on the upper-left quadrant of the left lobe; high-intensity clusters are concentrated at the terminal distal points of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A wide, shallow U-shaped central depression; the angle is approximately 140 degrees with a shallow depth-to-width ratio relative to the total fluke horizontal span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Asymmetrical topography; the left lobe trailing edge features high-amplitude, jagged, and irregular peaks and valleys; the right lobe trailing edge exhibits more uniform, medium-frequency micro-serrations with consistent periodicity.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a wide concave curve; the right lobe terminates in a tapered, upward-sweeping point, while the left lobe exhibits a more truncated, vertical distal boundary.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of localized high-contrast white pixel clusters at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; additional smaller high-contrast clusters detected along the lower jagged edge of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular indentation and loss of pixel area on the mid-section of the left lobe trailing edge; distinct high-contrast white ring-shaped feature on the left lobe's upper dorsal-facing surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The left lobe distal edge shows a unique pixel-level irregularity and vertical truncation compared to the more typical tapered geometry of the right lobe distal tip.
